statements.t: The divestiture and strategic partnership with DHL are expected to enhance the Company’s ability to develop its business, particularly in the EMEA and APAC regions, and to provide differentiated and high-value services aligned with the Company’s long-term growth strategy.

The Company intends to use a portion of its existing cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments to repay the $186.2 million principal amount of its outstanding 0.75% Convertible Senior Notes due in 2026 (the “2026 Convertible Senior Notes”) upon maturity in December 2026.
Following this repayment, the Company expects to retain substantial liquidity to support its ongoing operations and strategic priorities.

We expect to continue to incur significant expenses and operating losses in the near term as we invest in new supply chain initiatives, geographic expansion, and technology to support anticipated growth.
No assurance can be given that additional capital, if needed, will be available when required or upon terms acceptable to the Company.

The Company’s management believes that, based on its current plans and assumptions, which include the repayment of the 2026 Convertible Senior Notes at maturity in December 2026, the current cash and cash equivalents on hand, short-term investments, together with projected cash flows, will satisfy our operational and capital requirements for at least the next twelve months.

statements.t: “Our strong year-to-date performance, combined with expanding support of commercial therapies, deepening customer relationships, a robust clinical trial pipeline, and continued demand for MVE’s industry-leading products, gives us confidence in our outlook.
As a result, we are increasing our full-year 2026 revenue guidance to a range of $197 million to $199 million,” concluded Mr.

Two of Cryoport’s customers filed Biologics License Applications (BLA) with the FDA in the third quarter and we anticipate another five possible BLA or Marketing Authorization Applications (MAA) in 2026.

Cryoport also anticipates two possible additional new therapy approvals (both of which have received Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) dates from the FDA for Q4 2026), and one possible additional supplemental approval for geographic expansion from our customer base this year.

Further information on Cryoport’s financial results is included in the attached condensed consolidated balance sheets and statements of operations, and additional explanations of Cryoport’s financial performance are provided in the Company’s Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, which is expected to be filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC") on November 5, 2026.
The conference call will be in the format of a questions and answers session and will address any queries investors have regarding the Company’s reported results.

The questions and answers call will be recorded and available approximately three hours after completion of the live event in the Investor Relations section of the Company's website at www.cryoportinc.com for a limited time.
